div.div:
أَسْلَخُ , applied to a man, (JK,) (assumed tropical:) Very red [as though skinned]. (JK, K.) ―
-b2- And [its pl.] سَلْخَى, applied to camels, (assumed tropical:) Having mange, or scab, by which they are excoriated. (JK.) ―
-b3- Also (assumed tropical:) Bald in the fore part of the head: (K:) but أَسْلَجُ is more common in this sense. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
